argument: Exact original vertices are at radius at most140001um; their convex combinations (including the filled polygon) are within that disk. Rotation preserves radius; moving the reference to the floored center adds a vector of norm strictly below sqrt(2), yielding radius less than140003um. Every listed integer-normal halfplane contains that radius disk by the verified Cauchy bound d>=R*sqrt(nx^2+ny^2). Their independently verified convex polygon encloses the source for every angle. For centerY in[lo,hi], source area below band a is no greater than polygon area below a-lo, and source area above b is no greater than polygon area above b-hi, by monotonicity. Subtract both outward-rounded caps from the inward-rounded source area; max with zero is a valid integer lower bound. Existing source strips are disjoint and contained; their band-area sum is piecewise linear in centerY and reaches its minimum at a checked endpoint or breakpoint. Taking the maximum of the two valid lower bounds remains necessary. The full relaxed-stock band directly contains every valid source placement, so the exact inward-rounded full area applies there. This argument never treats the outer polygon as filled collision geometry. Original-polygon samples corroborate the proof but do not establish angle completeness.
capacity_rule: All disjoint original filled sources inside relaxed stock must have total band intersection area at most stock width times band height. Add each noncog source-contained rectangle intersection area once, and one cog lower bound for its complete Y bin. Source holes are reserved by PIH OFF.
